top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A television was not anchored to the table it was sitting on.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of the inspection the primary caregiver s First Aid and CPR certification was expired.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The most recent inspection report was not posted.
